name: Dumbbell calf raise

phases.name: rise
phases.cue: Rise onto the balls of your feet

formTips: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, feet hip-width
Rise straight up onto the balls of your feet as high as you can
Pause and squeeze your calves at the top
Lower your heels slowly; stand on a step to let the heels drop below your toes for more stretch
commonMistakes: Rolling onto the outsides of the feet
Bending the knees to push up
Cutting the range short at the top
